model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with each criterion. The horizontal axis, labeled “Criterion,” displays the criteria in alphabetical order: “FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Relevance Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” “Veracity Explanation,” and “Clarity Explanation.” The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” ranges from 0 to 6, with tick intervals of 2, and represents the quantity of participants for each criterion. The bar corresponding to “FCs” has a height of approximately 6, the bar for “FC Summary” reaches a height of 5, “Relevance Explanation” is represented by a bar with a height of 3, “Relevance Clarity and Simplicity” is also represented by a bar of height 3, “Overall Summary” displays a bar of height 2, “Filters” is indicated by a bar of height 1, “Veracity Explanation” is shown by a bar of height 1, and “Clarity Explanation” has a height of 0. All bars are of the same color, a shade of purple. The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
